== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Reegesk (Japanese)|Reegesk]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160005378/xlC7-suDzEScAmioJZvrtw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 93071762.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a69d5cb599cfbd031ea156620bd8849eb90aee5c62e8776dd3fa978bfa0c6677</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
